title: 26 U.S.C. 7503, Time for performance of acts where last day falls on Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday (U.S. Code 2024 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, United States Code

passages.question: Is March 15, 2027 the extended date, and does it move for a weekend?
passages.excerpt: When the last day prescribed under authority of the internal revenue laws for performing any act falls on Saturday, Sunday, or a legal holiday, the performance of such act shall be considered timely if it is performed on the next succeeding day
